determination_basis: TYPED BY HAND (session 118): Accenture LLP is a for-profit consulting firm (vendor dictionary: Accenture, CONSULTING_BIG), not a nonprofit. The state's own FFATA filing (PSC 27-630-1000-1007, 2026-10-28, $128,979,618.21) says what the money buys: '(RHT) ACCENTURE LLP WILL PROVIDE ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES ORGANIZATION (ASO) SUPPORT FOR THE NEW MEXICO RURAL HEALTH TRANSFORMATION PROGRAM (RHTP)'. A vendor administering the programme: NON_HOSPITAL. Whether any of it reaches providers is not on the filing (hospital_benefiting Unclear); never a hospital dollar. SESSION 119: HCA's ASO RFP 26-630-1000-0019 (Appendix F.3 s.3.1.10) has the ASO 'process and issue payments to RHTP-funded entities', and the amount is about six times the statute's 10% administrative cap on NM's allotment ($21,148,474), so most of it is very likely programme money Accenture DISBURSES, not its fee. Neither the fee nor the pass-through share is published (HCA, 11-16: 'Selection complete; announcement will be made by November 30, 2026'). Held OUT of NM's published-award total and the >=50% subset test (flag ADMINISTRATOR_PASS_THROUGH_UNRESOLVED) until a state source splits it.
